I have 1.71 hectares of sorghum to manage this season, and with the rains coming, I need to plan carefully. I will use improved seed because it gives better yield against the striga weed we often face here, and I will apply both organic manure and some chemical fertilizer to feed the soil. I cannot afford irrigation, so I am relying on the rains, but I will hire a few laborers to help with planting and weeding since my family cannot manage all the work alone.
